finding.issue: The P6.1b candidate does not establish the frozen real-evidence certification boundary required by TASK-165. All six committed manifest observed_at values are 2026-09-08T01:30:00+00:00 through 01:55:00+00:00 in exact five-minute increments, which predates canonical TASK-165 authoring on main at 2026-09-08T02:33:14Z. The required ShopeeScrapeTool path calls ShopeeSourceExtractor.extract without an observed_at override, and that extractor assigns datetime.now(timezone.utc), so these values cannot be accepted as exact unedited TASK-165 implementation-time capture provenance. The offline regression also directly calls deserialize_product_source_pack for all six manifests and later invokes TASK-138 with the two observation directories instead of the one cohort fixture root, violating the hard requirement that each cohort be rehydrated only through TASK-138 on its explicit cohort root exactly once. In addition, the deterministic provider infers hit presence by parsing rendered prompt markers such as H001-W001 / Retrieved Context rather than branching only on the already-built context hit boolean. Finally, the baseline document labels case-003 a lexical incompleteness mode even though the selected listing is a lantern unrelated to the Human intent chuột không dây; under the fixed cohort-label semantics this is a discovery/relevance-label mismatch and does not isolate a lexical-retrieval deficiency.
